Business Overview:[1][2][3]
JAFL is registered as a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Financial Company in Kolkata. 
It is in the business of:
a) Investment in securities of listed and unlisted entities 
b) Providing of loan and advances to SMEs
c) Share and derivative trading
